gateway_note: How this gateway is running right now. Pausing stops new workflow steps; the console and connected apps keep answering.
refresh_tip: Reload the loaded models, memory and GPU state

pause.label: Workflows paused
pause.title: On: no new workflow step starts until you switch it off; work already inside a call finishes first

check.label: Check now
check.title: Check for a newer release: an AbstractFramework installer install compares with the newest AbstractFramework release, any other install with the newest AbstractGateway on PyPI (needs internet)

update.label: Update
update.title: Install it in the background (an installer install runs the AbstractFramework installer); restart to finish

show_cached.label: Show configured / cached
show_cached.title: Also show configured / cached rows that are NOT resident in memory — informational only, nothing to unload

lock_in_memory.label: lock in memory
lock_in_memory.title: Lock the model in memory after loading so nothing can evict it until it is unlocked

load.label: Load model
load.title: Load (warm up) this model on the host now

estimate.label: Estimate
estimate.title: Ask the host how much context actually fits for this model (calibrated when it has measured)

rows.unlock_resident: Release the memory lock so this model can be unloaded or evicted
rows.unlock_evicted: Release a lock whose model is no longer in memory (the lock still blocks unloads)
rows.lock_adopt: Lock this model in memory — this host loaded it outside the Gateway, so locking adopts it first
rows.lock: Lock this model in memory so nothing can evict it

unload.label: Unload
unload.title: Unload this model from host memory

clear.label: Clear
clear.title: Clear every prompt cache for this session

confirms.restart: Restart AbstractGateway? Running workflows pause at their next step and continue after the restart. The console is unavailable for a few seconds.
confirms.quit: Quit AbstractGateway? Workflows stop and this console goes offline until you start AbstractGateway again.
confirms.unload: Unload {name} from host memory? The next request that needs it pays the full load again.
confirms.force: {name} is locked in memory — the lock exists to keep it resident. Force the unload anyway?
confirms.clear_cache: Clear every prompt cache for session {session}? The next turn re-encodes its prompt from scratch — nothing durable is lost.

empty.caches: No session prompt caches right now.
